items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Carlos Gastel, when he came on the scene he changed all of that. He changed the contract and changed, you know, saw to it that I did get it.

ctx.x: How many records did you do under that?

Oh, well, I guess the first batch of records, because that was before I had a manager, you know. And of course when Carlos Gastel came into the picture -- we're getting a little ahead in this, because I'm even getting ahead of how I got -- how I got recognized.
